description: South Arts — Southern Artist Spotlight Grant (URL path)

gold_labels.deadline: Rolling basis starting April 15, 2026; must be submitted at least 60 days prior to project start date
gold_labels.funding_amount: Minimum $1,000. Maximum $8,000 for dance, $5,000 for film/music/literary/traditional/visual arts. Dollar-for-dollar cash match required. Minimum artist fee $2,000.
eligibility: 501(c)(3) nonprofit, unit of local/county/state government, or federally recognized tribal community
Based within South Arts' nine-state region (AL, FL, GA, KY, LA, MS, NC, SC, TN)
Must be a presenter/presenting organization (not a producing organization)
Engage an artist, company, or ensemble from South Arts' roster
Limited to one application per South Arts fiscal year or grant cycle
Projects must take place in applicant's state (unless special circumstances discussed with South Arts)
Past non-compliant grantees must complete conversation with program director Nikki Estes
required_sections: Strategic Contribution to the Arts Ecosystem
evaluation_criteria: Artistic Merit — Strategic Contribution to the Arts Ecosystem (5%)
gold_labels.funder_overview: Pilot grant program supported by the NEA to amplify work with exemplary Southern artists and increase access to arts programming in Southern communities. Grants awarded first-come, first-served. Projects require a public presentation plus an educational/community engagement component.
